legs: Single continuous steadicam move, no cuts. The camera follows the adults along the garden path onto the gravel terrace under the brick vaults; they walk on and out of frame to the side, and the camera settles at the near end of the long candlelit table, where the grandmother is already seated holding the blond toddler on her lap, the white haired man laughing beside her, the man with glasses passing a bowl, a girl filling glasses from a clay jug. Nobody walks up holding a child; only one toddler in the scene. Vertical 9:16 frame.
